front: Compound interest: on what amount is the rate paid?
back: On the whole balance, past interest included, not only on the deposit.

front: Why does a compound balance pull away from a simple one over time?
back: Each year's interest joins the balance and earns interest too, so every year starts from a bigger base.

front: Balance of deposit P after n years of yearly compounding at rate r?
100 at 5% a year for 10 years: simple total and compound total?
Effective annual rate of a quoted rate r paid m times a year?
Accounts that pay on different schedules: which rate do you compare?
back: The effective annual rate, not the quoted rate; more frequent payments raise it.
